info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Trading Book Oversight API
info.description: The Trading Book Oversight API facilitates the management and updates of trading book data for wholesale banking operations. This endpoint enables users to modify existing oversight details, ensuring compliance and effective risk management. Typical consumers include banking risk management teams and compliance officers who require flexible tools to oversee trading activity. Utilize this API to keep trading records current and align with regulatory changes.

patch.summary: Update a trading book oversight resource.
patch.description: This operation allows users to update the details of a specific trading book oversight identified by RES-100045. Ensure to provide the relevant fields that need to be modified in the request body.

requestBody.description: Update the trading book oversight for the specified resource. This request allows for modifications to various properties of the trading book oversight record identified by RES-100045.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the trading book oversight details have been updated.
